name: Baja Blast Championship Sponsored by Taco Bell
aka: Baja Blast Champion Sponsored by Taco Bell
epitaph: Its title history opens on a vacancy: Hot Mask held the belt first, then exited the territory suddenly enough that no in-fiction loss was ever staged, the title and a place in ADW's own lineage left open for him before El Triton won it back out of the resulting three-way. Sponsored by Taco Bell — the sponsorship is part of the legal name, said in full every time, without exception.
